items.title: Offline assessment and conversion with AI agents in AWS DMS
items.summary: Learn how to use an AI agent with AWS DMS Schema Conversion to assess and convert SQL Server database schemas from exported DDL scripts in Amazon S3, using offline source and virtual target mode. You can start migration planning before you have source database connectivity or a provisioned target.
items.creator: Nelly Susanto

items.title: Build an Oracle AWR-style report for RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL
items.summary: PostgreSQL has no built-in Oracle AWR equivalent. This post shows how to build an AWR-style, snapshot-based performance report for Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL using pg_stat_statements and pg_cron, producing top-SQL, database-activity, wait-event, and load-profile reports between any two snapshot IDs, entirely in SQL.
items.creator: Tushar Rajput

items.title: Migrate from Amazon EC2 to Amazon ElastiCache Serverless with zero downtime
items.summary: On October 20, 2026, Amazon ElastiCache introduced online migration to ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey from self-managed Valkey and Redis OSS on Amazon EC2 with zero downtime. This post shows what's supported at launch, how online migration works, and how to run a migration in the ElastiCache console.
items.creator: Rong Zhang
